function.name: list_tasks
function.description: List the tasks on the user's list, optionally filtered by status. Returns the matching tasks, oldest first; an empty list is a normal outcome.

status.description: Optional filter, either open or done. Omit it to list everything.

function.name: add_task
function.description: Put one new task on the list. The response carries the task id to report back to the user.

title.description: What the task is, in a few words, for example buy milk.

due.description: Optional due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-09-04.
